Recommendation: Scope repository policies to known principals and enable scan-on-push; where public distribution is intended, migrate to ECR Public or CloudFront-fronted distribution instead. scenario.description: ECR (Elastic Container Registry) is AWS's managed Docker image registry. Container images in private pipelines should never be publicly accessible — they often contain proprietary application code, internal tooling, or dependencies that could help an attacker understand your systems. A repository policy with Principal:* means anyone on the internet can pull your images without authentication. the agent should identify ECR repositories with public access enabled or overly permissive pull policies.
